notes: US name 'motorola razr - 2023'; EU/global name 'Razr 40' - one physical device, two regional names. Source is the US motorola.com store page (productName 'motorola razr - 2023', Snapdragon 7 Gen 1, 1.5-inch external display) read via web.archive.org snapshot dated 2023-12-22 because the live URL now 301s to the razr family page; the archived document is motorola.com's own, so tier=primary per SPEC. The Razr 40 pairing itself is NOT stated on any Motorola page reachable today: motorola.com no longer serves any razr 40 page in any locale probed (gb/au/ae/nz/in all 404/500) and both Motorola newsrooms are robots-blocked, so the alias is carried from the task brief and remains UNVERIFIED against a manufacturer page. Motorola lists dimensions as W x H x D ('73.95 x 170.82 x 7.35mm'); 73.95 mapped to width and the larger figure to height. resolution_px recorded in Motorola's own print order - main '2640 x 1080' is long-axis-first, external '194 x 368' is short-axis-first, so the two are not consistently ordered by Motorola. panel 'OLED' is the SPEC enum value for Motorola's stated 'pOLED'/'AMOLED'. announced/released null: no reachable manufacturer press release (motorolanews.com and news.lenovo.com both Disallow ClaudeBot). hinge.crease and hinge.free_stop null - no teardrop/Flex View wording on this page. materials.back: Motorola says 'Vegan leather (finishing)' with no separate frame-vs-back split.
